title: DOE Notes of Calls on FOIA Request HQ-2021-00588-F, 2021

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All records created between April 14, 2021 and September 30, 2021 that memorialize, summarize, schedule or document any telephone call, video call, Microsoft Teams (or similar) meeting or chat, or in-person conversation between DOE Headquarters FOIA Office staff (including Alexander Morris, Natonne Kemp and Todd Burns) and National Nuclear Security Administration FOIA staff (including Christina Hamblen) concerning the processing of FOIA request HQ-2021-00588-F, also referred to in emails as the "WNP case." This includes:

1. Handwritten or typed notes, memoranda to file, summaries and recordings of any such call or conversation.

2. Calendar entries, meeting invitations and phone logs for any such call or conversation, including on or about April 19, April 21-22, May 19, June 14-15 and July 5-12, 2021.

3. Teams, Skype, text or other instant messages sent in connection with any such call or conversation, or about HQ-2021-00588-F generally.

4. The attachments listed in Natonne Kemp's July 12, 2021 email to Todd Burns, "HQ-2021-00588-F No Doc Final Response," namely: the request; the jurisdiction check; the "Table of Program Offices consulted"; the two "ACM" documents ("prepare no doc for AU" and "add NNSA to no doc"); and the no-doc final letter, including drafts.

5. Any notes or records memorializing consultation with the program office identified as "AU-60" on HQ-2021-00588-F, including the item tracked as "Ticket Number: AU1-F-21-N1-0020."

Please search the email accounts, calendars, chat accounts and shared drives of the staff named above and of the other DOE Headquarters FOIA staff who worked on HQ-2021-00588-F, not only for the term "HQ-2021-00588-F," but also for "WNP," "Petti," "Jurisdiction check," "no doc" and "Klotz."

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the FOIA requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

title: NJEDA: Booker letters of support and correspondence

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New Jersey Open Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Letters of support, endorsement letters, or other written statements from Mayor Cory Booker, the City of Newark Office of the Mayor, or U.S. Sen. Cory Booker submitted to or received by the New Jersey Economic Development Authority between July 1, 2006 and November 23, 2026 in connection with any application for an incentive, tax credit, grant, or loan, including under the Urban Transit Hub Tax Credit Program, the Grow New Jersey Assistance Program, and the Business Employment Incentive Program.

2. Emails and letters between the New Jersey Economic Development Authority (the Office of the CEO and Government Affairs staff) and the City of Newark Office of the Mayor or Brick City Development Corporation between July 1, 2006 and October 31, 2013 including the following words/phrases: "Booker", "Prudential", "Panasonic", "Teachers Village", "Urban Transit Hub".

3. Emails sent or received between January 1, 2024 and November 23, 2026 by the Office of the CEO and Government Affairs staff of the New Jersey Economic Development Authority to or from any email address ending in "@booker.senate.gov".

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the Open Public Records Act requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
